Manufacturing · FOUNDING EDITION / 16 OCT 2026

Could discarded conch shell become a useful Bahamian product?

Bahama Mineral Co. is working toward poultry calcium and other material applications.

BY CARIBBEAN BUSINESS ATLAS · COMMENTARY & COMPANY RESEARCH

Conch shell is a familiar part of Bahamian life, but commercial uses for the discarded shell have historically been limited. The material raises an interesting manufacturing question: what products could be made locally from a resource already present?

Bahama Mineral Co. describes a pre-commercial effort to recover and process conch shell, with poultry calcium as its first intended application. Its website also discusses potential uses in design and other material markets.

The key distinction is between a potential application and a validated, commercially available product. Product specifications, testing, economics and a functioning supply chain must be demonstrated before a business case is established.
